title: Perfect Fried Green Tomatoes
description: This recipe for crispy fried green tomatoes comes complete with a Cajun-spiced ranch sauce for dipping. Simple, yet delicious and guaranteed to impress!
ingredients: salt and ground black pepper to taste
2 cups canola oil, or as needed

steps.text: Season tomato slices with salt and pepper.

Combine flour, 1 teaspoon salt, and 1 teaspoon pepper in a shallow bowl. Pour buttermilk into a second shallow bowl. Mix cornmeal, parsley, paprika, 1 teaspoon salt, 1 teaspoon pepper, and cayenne pepper in a third shallow bowl.

Dredge each tomato slice in flour mixture to coat, dip into buttermilk, and finish by pressing both sides of tomato into cornmeal mixture to coat. Lay coated tomato slices on a baking sheet; set aside to let tomatoes absorb the coating, 10 to 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a deep-fryer or large saucepan to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Gently drop tomato slices into hot oil and cook until crispy, golden brown and floating, 2 to 3 minutes. Drain on a plate lined with paper towels.
To make the dipping sauce: Whisk ranch dressing, Cajun seasoning, and hot pepper sauce together in a small bowl. Serve sauce with fried tomato slices.

video.description: Give into your green tomato love and impress everyone with your frying finesse! This recipe makes the best and crispest fried green tomatoes—they’re perfect! Dredge seasoned green tomatoes in a mixture of flour, salt and black pepper, then dunk in buttermilk, and finally finish by dipping in a coarse coating of cornmeal, parsley, paprika, salt, black pepper and cayenne pepper. Allow to rest, then deep-fry for a few minutes and serve with a deliciously spicy sauce of ranch dressing, Cajun seasoning and hot pepper sauce.
